caption_txt.title: Feeling Confused About Your Next Visa Step? PFEC Global's Migration360 Roadshow Is Coming to Your City
body: Oh my God, my visa is expiring and I still don't know what to do — sound familiar? You're not alone. Every year, thousands of international students finish studying and freeze at this exact moment: are you eligible for a skilled migration visa, do you go for the 485 visa, or do you need to continue studying further?
For this reason, to help you decide on your next steps, PFEC Global is bringing the Migration360 Roadshow to your city. Bring your questions and walk out with an actual plan — not more confusion.
